integrity: Analytical proof provided; finite exact computations are supplementary and not substituted for universal proof. An inaccessible historical source is disclosed, not falsely marked excluded.
limitations: Independent years and a beta-distributed annual common weather factor; conditionally iid patches; density-independent globally pooled seed bank.
The theorem concerns logarithmic growth, not extinction probability or evolutionarily stable resource allocation.
The general critical-case asymptotic rate is unproved.
Full text of Venable and Brown (1988) could not be obtained; exact bibliographic overlap remains possible.
title: Correlated patch weather creates a sharp dormant-seed phase transition
